currentContext.business: The Company carried out no operating business activities during FY2025-26 and generated no revenue from operations, earning only other income; segment-wise performance was stated to be not applicable. Following BSE approval for revocation of the suspension of trading in its equity shares and a completed preferential fund raise, management describes itself as identifying sustainable business opportunities and building a diversified business platform. It operates from a registered office at Bardoli, Surat (Gujarat) and a corporate office at Sakinaka, Andheri East, Mumbai, and was renamed from CHPL Industries Limited to Callista Industries Limited during the year.

Not a body corporate - country of incorporation and nature of business stated as Not Applicable.

currentContext.strategies: Reactivate the Company as a going business following BSE approval for revocation of the suspension of trading in its equity shares, described by management as a turning point enabling it to pursue long-term business objectives.|Expand business operations through the proposed incorporation or acquisition of a subsidiary.|Identify sustainable, profitable business opportunities and build a diversified business platform rather than a single line of activity.|Deploy the proceeds of the preferential fund raise to commence business expansion in forthcoming periods while maintaining financial discipline and prudent utilisation of resources.|Strengthen corporate governance and progressively strengthen the internal control framework in line with future expansion plans.|Build a capable workforce as the Company moves into its next phase of growth.
currentContext.expansion: The Company disclosed no plant, capacity or physical capex programme. Expansion in FY2025-26 was corporate rather than industrial: BSE approved revocation of the suspension of trading in the Company's equity shares with effect from 19th August, 2025; the Company obtained in-principle approval from BSE for raising funds from promoters and non-promoters through a preferential issue of equity shares and convertible warrants aggregating up to Rs. 35.00 Crores, subsequently revised to Rs. 26.90 Crores, and management states the preferential fund raise was successfully completed. The Company has initiated strategic steps towards expanding its business operations, including the proposed incorporation or acquisition of a subsidiary, and says the funds raised have positioned it to commence business expansion in the forthcoming periods. No commissioning dates, site locations, capacity additions or project timelines were given, and the Company carried out no operating business activities during the year.
currentContext.mdna: Management states the Indian economy continues to provide encouraging opportunities for businesses across various sectors.|Management says that with a strengthened financial position, an active listed status and strategic expansion initiatives, the Company is well placed to evaluate and pursue new business opportunities.|No demand or volume narrative exists for FY26: the Company did not carry out any operating business activities during the year, so segment-wise performance was stated to be not applicable and there was no revenue from operations.|Future performance is stated to depend on the revocation of suspension, the preferential fund raise and the proposed expansion through a subsidiary rather than on any existing product or end-market demand.

risks.risk: No operating business and no revenue
risks.note: The Company did not carry out any operating business activities during FY2025-26 and generated no revenue from operations, earning only other income; segment-wise performance was stated to be not applicable. There is no existing cash-generating business to fall back on.

risks.risk: Execution risk in entering new business segments
risks.note: Management explicitly flags the risks associated with entering new business segments as it progresses towards expanding operations; the intended business is not yet named and would be run through a subsidiary that is only proposed for incorporation or acquisition.
Explicitly listed by management among the risks it recognises as it expands into new business segments.

Explicitly listed by management among the risks it recognises; with no operating base, the Company's plan to identify and enter a new business is directly exposed to the opportunity set the economy offers.

The Secretarial Auditor reported that the Company has some irregularities in compliance with the Act, Rules, Regulations, Guidelines, Standards and Listing Agreement, and specifically named non-compliances: the FY2024-25 AGM was held on 15th December, 2025 against a 30th September, 2025 deadline, there was a delay in the appointment of an Independent Director, and a 12-day delay in appointing the Company Secretary and Compliance Officer under Regulation 6 of SEBI (LODR).

Trading in the Company's equity shares was under suspension until BSE approved revocation with effect from 19th August, 2025; the resumption of trading is itself described as the enabler of the Company's plans, so continued listing compliance is load-bearing.

During the year the CFO and Whole Time Director, the Company Secretary, three non-executive directors and one independent director resigned, new independent directors, a CFO and a Company Secretary were appointed, and several board resolutions - an authorised-capital increase to Rs. 55 crores and two preferential issues approved on 05th November, 2025, plus two non-executive director appointments approved on 12th August, 2025 - were subsequently withdrawn by the Board.

risks.risk: Internal controls sized to a dormant company
risks.note: Internal controls are stated to be adequate only as commensurate with the current size and nature of operations, with the framework to be strengthened in line with future expansion plans - a gap that widens if a new operating business is acquired before controls are built out.
